request.questionText: The distribution of annual of snowfall in Lubbock, Texas has a symmetric bell-shape, with an average of 8.6 inches and standard deviation 2.5 inches. Using this distribution, what is the probability of an annual snowfall of between 7 and 11 inches in a given year in Lubbock?
